name: ZCA_FEED_ELEMENTS
description: This table stores the feed elements for a given top level object feed.

columns.name: FEED_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table.

columns.name: FEED_OBJ_ID
columns.description: The id of the top level object that owns the feed element.

columns.name: FEED_OBJ_TYPE
columns.description: The name of the top level object that owns the feed element.

columns.name: EVENT_OBJ_TYPE
columns.description: The name of the actual object that owns the feed element.

columns.name: EVENT_OBJ_ID
columns.description: The id of the actual object that owns the feed element.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJ_ID
columns.description: The id of the parent object that owns the feed element.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJ_TYPE
columns.description: The name of the parent object that owns the feed element.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of event that generated the feed (e.g. CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE).

columns.name: EVENT_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: Event timestamp of the cloud event.

columns.name: SIGNAL_ID
columns.description: The id of signal generated for the cloud event.

columns.name: SIGNAL_DEF_ID
columns.description: Signal definition id of the cloud event.

columns.name: SIGNAL_CORRELATION_ID
columns.description: Signal correlation id of the cloud event.

columns.name: ACTOR_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The party id of the actor who created the event.

columns.name: ACTOR_USERNAME
columns.description: The user name of the actor who created the event.

columns.name: ACTOR_TYPE
columns.description: The type of the actor, examples are Person, ESS System etc.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PAYLOAD
columns.description: The payload representing the cloud event.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME
columns.description: Name of the system which generates the cloud event.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
